name: Desert Hills Premium Outlets
summary: Desert Hills Premium Outlets is an upscale outdoor shopping destination in Cabazon featuring high-end designer fashion outlets at discounted prices. Located conveniently between Los Angeles and Palm Springs, this popular center offers premium brand shopping with casual dining options in an open-air setting.
demographics: Desert Hills Premium Outlets attracts affluent shoppers and tourists from Southern California's Inland Empire, Palm Springs, and greater Los Angeles area, with a strong presence of middle to upper-middle income households seeking designer brands at discounted prices. The center draws a diverse mix of domestic and international tourists, particularly from Asia and Latin America, who visit as part of their Southern California travel itineraries. Primary visitors include fashion-conscious adults aged 25-54 with household incomes exceeding $75,000, as well as families making day trips from surrounding communities seeking premium brand shopping experiences at outlet pricing.
description: Desert Hills Premium Outlets stands as Southern California's premier outdoor outlet shopping destination, strategically located in Cabazon along Interstate 10 between Los Angeles and Palm Springs. This upscale open-air center has established itself as a must-visit shopping experience, featuring an impressive collection of high-end designer fashion outlets that offer significant savings on luxury and premium brands. The center's thoughtfully designed outdoor layout creates a pleasant shopping environment where visitors can browse through stores offering everything from designer apparel and accessories to home goods and specialty items. With operating hours from 10 AM to 9 PM daily, the center provides ample time for both local residents and tourists to explore its extensive retail offerings. The combination of premium brand selection, outlet pricing, and convenient location has earned Desert Hills Premium Outlets an exceptional 4.5-star rating from over 11,500 reviews, complemented by casual dining options that allow shoppers to refuel during their retail adventures.
